notes.text: NOTES
THE SIGNALLING ARRANGEMENT IS SUITABLE FOR 25KV AC TRACTION.
ALL SIGNAL LAMPS ARE OF LED TYPE.
ALL CHAINAGES ARE SHOWN WITH RESPECT TO CENTRE LINE OF SCMN STATION BUILDING (CSB) AS 0.00M.
ALL POINTS ARE 1 IN 8 1/2.
ALL POINTS ARE MOTOR OPERATED, EXCEPT OTHERWISE INDICATED.
OPERATION OF E.I. IS FROM VISUAL DISPLAY UNIT ONLY WITH A STAND BY VDU.
`ON' ASPECT OF UP/DN HOME & UP/DN ADV. STR. SIGNALS ARE TO BE PROVED IN RESPECTIVE BLOCK/SLOT CIRCUITS.
BSLB SHOULD BE ELECTRICALLY LIT.

AS PER IRSEM/2021, PARA 17.7.5, FOR MSDAC, ZONE VERIFICATION BUTTON'S PROVIDED AT SITE IN LINE VERFICATION BOX / CRANK HANDLE BOX, INSTALLED NEAR THE AXLE COUNTER ZONE. DURING FAILURE OF MSDAC IN STATION YARD, THE RESETTING SHALL BE COOPERATIVE AND DONE JOINTLY BY THE ON DUTY ASM ALONG WITH ANOTHER OPERATING STAFF, WHO SHALL VERIFY PHYSICAL CLEARANCE OF LINE AND PRESS THE ZONE VERIFICATION BUTTON FOR THE FAILED TRACK SECTION OF AXLE COUNTER.
DURING FAILURE OF MSDAC BETWEEN RYD-DYD BLOCK SECTION, SM/RYD WILL RESET THE 'MSDAC' AFTER RECEIVING THE RESET-PERMISSION FROM SM/DYD, AFTER ENSURING THAT NO TRAIN IS AVAILABLE IN THE BLOCK SECTION.

FOR STARTER SIGNALS WHICH ARE PLACED AT 3M FROM CONCERNED AXLE COUNTER DETECTION DEVICE & 5 SEC TIME DELAY TO BE PROVIDED IN HR CIRCUIT AS PER RAILWAY BOARD LETTER No. 2012/SIG/SEM-II/MISC, DT 10.10.2012.
VIDE S.R -1.03.01(a) RYD YARD IS A 'SPECIAL CLASS STATION'.
COMPETENT AUTHORIRTY'S DISPENSATION IS TO BE OBTAINED IN TERMS OF GR. 3.07(7) FOR ;-
FOR COMBINING OF DIST SIGNAL (OF HOME 78, KK LINE) WITH ADV STR SIG S70 OF DYD YARD.
FOR COMBINING OF DIST SIGNAL (OF HOME 82, ECOR LINE) WITH ADV STR SIG S72 OF DYD YARD.
FOR COMBINING OF DIST SIGNAL (OF HOME 86, GPT LINE) WITH ADV STR SIG S74 OF DYD YARD.
FOR COMBINING OF DIST SIGNAL (OF HOME 70, SCMN LINE) WITH ADV STR SIG S76 OF DYD YARD.
FOR COMBINING OF UP DIST SIGNAL (OF HOME S1, GPT GOODS RECEPTION LINE) WITH UP ADV STARTER 23 OF GPT.
SLOT EXTENTED FROM RECEIVING STATION WILL PROVE NO LIGHT PROTECTION OF THE DESTINATION SIGNAL.

IN TERMS OF GR.3.47, PCOM/ECOR/BBS SPECIAL INSTRUCTION IS OBTAINED VIDE ECOR/OPTG/SC/55/XV/Spl.Inst/WMY, DATED-23.12.2021, FOR ALLOWING SIMULTANEOUS RECEPTIONS OR RECEPTION/DISPATCH OF TRAINS, WHEN TWO OR MORE TRAINS ARE APPROACHING SIMULTANEOUSLY FROM ANY DIRECTION, KEEPING 120M OF PHYSICAL SEPARATION, BEING A GOODS YARD.

PCOM/ECOR/BBS's SPECIAL INSTRUCTION IS OBTAINED VIDE ECOR/OPTG/SC/55/XV/Spl.Inst/WMY, DATED-23.12.2021, THAT ''FOR SHUNTING MOVEMENTS ON NON-ISOLATED LINES, 120 METERS GAP BETWEEN THE PATH OF TRAINS IS NOT REQUIRED IN TERMS WITH RLY BOARD'S LETTER NO.2008/SAFETY(A&R)/19/5. DTD.14.05.2010 AND AS PER SUBSIDIARYRULES SR.5.16.01 OF EAST COAST RAILWAY''.

AS PER PCOM/ECOR/BBS's SPECIAL INSTRUCTION IS OBTAINED VIDE ECOR/OPTG/SC/55/XV/Spl.Inst/WMY, DATED-23.12.2021, THIS YARD IS TERMED AS TERMINAL YARD WITH 15KMPH RESTICTION, HENCE ADEQUATE SIGNAL OVERLAP FOR RECEPTION OF TRAINS ARE DISPENSED WITH IN TERMS OF G.R. 3.40(I).
